internships.summary: Built a production-ready, full-stack Asset Management System featuring role-based access control, employee management, online asset tracking, and maintenance monitoring.
key_contributions: Architected scalable backend RESTful microservices using Spring Boot and Spring Data JPA with MySQL database integration.
Built dynamic, responsive user interfaces in React.js styled with Tailwind CSS, utilizing Axios for seamless API communication.
Implemented secure role-based access control (RBAC) separating administrative controls from standard employee actions.
Engineered an administrative dashboard with real-time analytics, equipment status tracking, maintenance schedules, and audit logs.
Deployed frontend onto Vercel and backend microservices onto Render cloud, achieving high reliability and reducing manual tracking effort.

internships.summary: Led the end-to-end development of a comprehensive portfolio and e-commerce retail platform.
key_contributions: Designed clean, responsive web pages and user-friendly product and project catalogs.
Implemented interactive shopping cart, order checkout flows, contact form integration, and profile management.
Integrated Node.js backend logic for processing orders and inquiries.
Ensured cross-browser compatibility and optimized page load speed.
